info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Proposition Management API
info.description: The Customer Proposition Management API allows businesses to modify existing customer propositions efficiently. This endpoint enables users to update the details of specific propositions, ensuring they reflect the latest offerings and customer preferences. Typical consumers include customer relationship managers and marketing teams seeking to enhance their engagement strategies. By utilizing this API, companies can tailor their services to meet customer needs in a rapidly changing market.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer proposition identified by CUST-100045. Utilize this operation to modify attributes such as pricing, terms, and associated services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the existing customer proposition with identifier CUST-100045. Include the necessary fields that need to be modified as per the schema defined for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the customer proposition has been updated.
